items.title: Bitmine Buys $41M More Ethereum, Reaching 99% of Its 'Alchemy of 5%' Target
items.summary: The purchase lifts Bitmine's stash past 6 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its "Alchemy of 5%" goal—as chairman Tom Lee says Ethereum is "dwarfing" other macro assets.

items.title: DeFi Development sees NAV per share more than doubling, holds 2.56 million SOL
items.summary: DFDV says preliminary Q3 estimates show NAV per share more than doubled as its Solana treasury grew to 2.56 million SOL.

items.title: Tim Draper's Firm Leads Strategic Round In Bitcoin Wallet Xverse
items.summary: Trust Machines and Draper Dragon joined the round.

items.title: Metaplanet reveals net income strategy to fuel Bitcoin accumulation
items.summary: Metaplanet revealed a revised capital allocation framework proposing to allocate as much as 15% of total assets to strategic investments to fund its Bitcoin accumulation.
